저.forms: subject: 제가 · object: 저를 · my: 제 (제 이름)
저.ex: 제 이름은 마이클이에요. 저는 미국 사람이에요.
저.x: My name is Michael. I'm American.
저.t: Use 저 whenever you speak politely. With 가 it becomes 제가, never 저가.

저.forms: 저 + noun: 저 사람 · 저 건물 · 저것 (that thing) · 저기 (over there)
저.x: That person over there is our teacher.
저.t: Same spelling as 저 'I (humble)'. Before a noun it means 'that over there'.

대.forms: native number + 대: 자동차 두 대 · 컴퓨터 한 대
대.ex: 우리 집에는 차가 한 대 있어요.
대.x: We have one car at home.
대.e: For cars and machines: 차 두 대 = two cars.
대.t: Also used for phones, TVs, bicycles and other devices.

약국.x: I bought cold medicine at the pharmacy.

쌀.x: You make cooked rice from raw rice.
쌀.t: 쌀 is raw rice; once cooked it's 밥. Pronounce the tense ㅆ sharply.

글.x: I wrote a short text in Korean.
글.e: 글씨 = handwriting; 글자 = letter, character; 한글 = Korean alphabet.
글.t: 말 is spoken language; 글 is written language.

찾다.m: to look for, to search; to find; to withdraw (money)
찾다.x: I'm looking for my bag right now.
찾다.e: Also 'withdraw money': 돈을 찾다. 찾아보다 = look something up.
찾다.t: 찾다 covers both 'look for' and 'find'; context decides. 찾았어요! = 'Found it!'

혀.ex: 뜨거운 국을 급하게 먹어서 혀가 아파요.
혀.x: I ate hot soup too fast, so my tongue hurts.

팀.t: 팀장 'team leader' is a very common job title at Korean companies.

말하기.m: speaking (as a skill or test section)
말하기.ex: 말하기 연습을 위해 한국 친구를 만나요.
말하기.x: I meet Korean friends to practice speaking.

흐르다.forms: 흘러요 · 흘렀어요 · 흐를 거예요 · 흐른 (+noun) (르 irregular)
흐르다.m: to flow, to run; to pass (time)
흐르다.x: The Han River flows slowly through the middle of Seoul.
흐르다.e: Its causative is 흘리다 'to spill, shed'.

아이고.m: oh my, oh dear, ouch, ugh
아이고.x: Oh, my back really hurts today.
아이고.e: Often softened to 아이구 or 에구 in speech.

에너지.ex: 에너지를 아끼려면 안 쓰는 전기 제품은 꺼 두세요.
에너지.x: To save energy, turn off electronics you aren't using.
에너지.e: From English 'energy'; note the ㅈ for the 'g' sound.

정직하다.ex: 그 사람은 정직해서 거짓말을 하지 않아요.
정직하다.x: That person is honest, so they don't lie.
정직하다.t: Pronounced [정지카다]; 정직하다 is morally honest, 솔직하다 is frank about feelings.

탑승.x: Boarding for the plane begins 30 minutes before departure.

분위기.x: This café has a quiet, nice atmosphere.
분위기.t: Useful phrases: 분위기 있다 'to be atmospheric' and 분위기를 깨다 'to kill the mood'.

지구촌.x: The Olympics are a festival for the whole world.
지구촌.e: Literally 'earth-ball village' — the whole world as one village.

설문 조사.ex: 학생 백 명을 대상으로 설문 조사를 했어요.
설문 조사.x: We conducted a survey of one hundred students.

가치관.x: Everyone has different values, so they think differently too.
가치관.e: -관 = outlook or view: 가치관, 인생관, 세계관.

퍼지다.m: to spread, get around; to become soggy (noodles)
퍼지다.ex: 그 소문이 학교 전체에 금방 퍼졌어요.
퍼지다.x: That rumor quickly spread throughout the whole school.
퍼지다.t: Koreans also say 라면이 퍼졌어요 when instant noodles have sat too long and gone soggy.

첨부 파일.x: Please check the attached file and get back to me.
첨부 파일.e: 첨부 'attaching' (literally 'add and attach') + 파일 from English 'file'.
첨부 파일.t: Useful lines: 파일을 첨부했습니다 'I've attached the file'; 첨부 파일이 안 열려요 'The attachment won't open'.

다문화.ex: 한국에도 다문화 학생이 점점 늘고 있어요.
다문화.x: The number of multicultural students is growing in Korea, too.

학문적.ex: 이 논문은 학문적으로 큰 가치가 있어요.
학문적.x: This paper has great academic value.
학문적.e: -적 turns a noun into '-ic/-al': 학문적, 과학적, 경제적.

세계 문화유산.m: World Heritage Site, world cultural heritage
세계 문화유산.x: Bulguksa Temple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
세계 문화유산.e: Literally 'world cultural heritage' — sites on UNESCO's protected list.

별안간.forms: 별안간 + event (별안간 비가 쏟아지다); noun: 별안간에
별안간.x: All of a sudden the sky darkened, and rain poured down.
별안간.e: Literally 'in the space of a glance'.

애초에.m: in the first place, from the very beginning
애초에.ex: 애초에 그 일을 맡지 말았어야 했어요.
애초에.x: I shouldn't have taken on that job in the first place.
애초에.e: 애초 'the very start' + -에; 초 means 'beginning', as in 초기 'early stage'.

대들다.forms: 대들어요 · 대들었어요 · 대들 거예요 · 대드세요 (ㄹ drops)
대들다.m: to talk back, to defy, to stand up to (a superior)
대들다.x: The child talked back to his parents for the first time.
대들다.t: Used toward someone above you, like a parent, teacher or boss.

시사점.ex: 이 연구는 교육 정책에 중요한 시사점을 줍니다.
시사점.x: This study offers important implications for education policy.
시사점.e: Literally 'point that shows and hints': what a finding suggests.

한가위.x: Have a happy Chuseok with your family.
한가위.e: Native word: 한 'great' + 가위, an old word for the 15th day of the eighth lunar month.
한가위.t: Common in greetings and in the saying 더도 말고 덜도 말고 한가위만 같아라 'no more, no less — may every day be like Hangawi'.

역주행.m: chart reversal, an old song climbing the charts again later; driving the wrong way
역주행.ex: 몇 년 전 노래가 갑자기 역주행해서 1위를 했어요.
역주행.x: A song from a few years ago suddenly climbed back up the charts and hit No. 1.
역주행.e: Literally 'running in reverse'; originally driving against traffic.
역주행.t: Pronounced [역쭈행]. It often happens after a fan video goes viral; the verb is 역주행하다.

국경.ex: 난민들이 국경을 넘어 이웃 나라로 피란했습니다.
국경.x: Refugees crossed the border and fled to a neighboring country.
국경.t: Pronounced [국꼉]; 국경을 넘다 'to cross the border' is the key collocation.

면하다.m: to escape, to avoid, to be spared (from); to be relieved of
면하다.ex: 다행히 큰 사고는 면했지만 차가 많이 망가졌어요.
면하다.x: Luckily we avoided a serious accident, but the car was badly damaged.
면하다.e: One syllable meaning 'exempt'; don't confuse it with 면하다 'to face (a street)'.
면하다.t: Set phrases: 꼴찌를 면하다 'avoid last place', 책임을 면하다 'escape responsibility'.

우러러보다.m: to look up to, to admire; to look up (at)
우러러보다.x: Many students looked up to that teacher.
우러러보다.e: 우러르다 'to raise one's head' + 보다 'to look'.
우러러보다.t: Korean uses the same up/down image as English: 우러러보다 'look up to' vs. 얕보다, 깔보다 'look down on'.

못을 박다.forms: 못을 박아요 · 못을 박았어요 · 못 박아 두다
못을 박다.m: to make something clear; to state firmly
못을 박다.ex: 사장님은 이번에는 연장이 없다고 못을 박았어요.
못을 박다.x: The boss made it clear there would be no extension this time.
못을 박다.e: Literally 'to hammer in a nail,' fixing a point so it won't move.
못을 박다.t: 가슴에 못을 박다 is different: to hurt someone deeply.

자주권.x: Every nation's sovereignty must be respected.
자주권.e: Literally 'right to be one's own master'. -권 = right: 인권, 선거권.
자주권.t: Don't mix it up with the adverb 자주 'often'; 자주권 uses the other 자주, 'autonomy'.

분리독립.x: Scotland held a referendum on independence.

빅뱅.x: The universe is known to have begun with the Big Bang.

강직하다.ex: 그는 강직한 성품으로 많은 존경을 받았어요.
강직하다.x: He was greatly respected for his upright character.
강직하다.e: Literally 'firm and straight' — someone who won't bend.

궁벽하다.ex: 그는 궁벽한 산골 마을에서 태어나 자랐어요.
궁벽하다.x: He was born and raised in a remote mountain village.
궁벽하다.e: Literally 'at the very end and off to the side'.

무람없다.ex: 어른께 그렇게 무람없이 굴면 안 돼요.
무람없다.x: You shouldn't act so disrespectfully toward your elders.
무람없다.e: Built with 없다 'lacking' — lacking proper reserve and modesty.

개념화.ex: 새로운 현상을 개념화하는 것은 쉽지 않아요.
개념화.x: Conceptualizing a new phenomenon isn't easy.
